data.name: Code Name: Boogeyman
data.detailed_description: Code Name: Boogeyman is a game created by a video game enthusiast who has poured his expertise and love for the genre into this ambitious project. This action-packed combat game draws inspiration from iconic films and video games to deliver an immersive and captivating experience. With a wide range of moves and combat mechanics, as well as meticulously crafted environments, Code Name: Boogeyman promises a unique and rewarding adventure for every player.

data.legal_notice: Code Name: Boogeyman is a fictional action fighting game for adults only. This game is therefore not recommended for children under 18-17 or 16 years old depending on your country. Typography used "Bebas Neue" created by Ryoichi Tsunekawa,available under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

content_descriptors.notes: Since *Codename: Boogeyman* is a fighting game, there can be a lot of blood at times. However, *Codename: Boogeyman* remains a game.
